crossRefs.note: For the entrance of the inner sanctuary, he made doors of olive wood. The lintel and door posts were a fifth part of…
In the first year of his reign, in the first month, he opened the doors of Yahweh’s house, and repaired them.

people.name: Assyria
people.line: A powerful ancient empire, often in conflict with Israel.

translations.web: At that time, Hezekiah cut off the gold from the doors of Yahweh’s temple, and from the pillars which Hezekiah king of Judah had overlaid, and gave it to the king of Assyria.
translations.bsb: At that time Hezekiah stripped the gold with which he had plated the doors and doorposts of the temple of the LORD, and he gave it to the king of Assyria.
translations.kjv: At that time did Hezekiah cut off the gold from the doors of the temple of the LORD, and from the pillars which Hezekiah king of Judah had overlaid, and gave it to the king of Assyria.
translations.asv: At that time did Hezekiah cut off the gold from the doors of the temple of Jehovah, and from the pillars which Hezekiah king of Judah had overlaid, and gave it to the king of Assyria.
